voice.summary: Speaks softly and slowly, like a teacher at the start of class. Short sentences, no hype, lots of room to breathe.
dos: Keep sentences short with room for a pause
Use sensory words: warm, soft, steady
Say what to expect before asking for anything

boilerplate: Stillwater Yoga is a small-class studio in Bath offering warm rooms, unhurried teachers and a weekly timetable that welcomes beginners, with a first class free.

microcopy.success: You're booked in, see you on the mat
microcopy.error: That class is full, try another time
microcopy.empty: No classes booked yet this week
